manualRules.text: Action; range 30/90 ft. Point within 30 ft requires no attack. Beyond 30 ft: DC 10 Dexterity check; failure lands 10 ft short. Expend one grenade on committed use. Use di.weapon.frag_grenade base mode for structured area, save DC, damage and per-target outcomes. Multi-target damage roll sharing is deferred; no default inferred.
manualRules.reason: Manual placement/target adjudication; mechanical save outcome is owned by the weapon mode (PHB-RULE-059), not duplicated here.
